name: Declutter the house
summary: Declutter room by room on a schedule that fits your sessions, with donate runs along the way.
duration: Set by your deadline, often 4 to 12 weeks

onboarding.prompt: Which rooms are on the list?
onboarding.reaction: Good list. We'll go easiest first.

phases.name: Room by room
benchmarks: One room every one to two weeks

plan_blueprint.calendar: Sessions on the chosen slots labelled by room, and donate runs every other week.

approach_variants.habit: Fifteen minutes a day after an existing routine (after dinner); streak of days tidied.
approach_variants.willpower: Weekend challenge: clear one whole room in a day, with a countdown to the deadline.
approach_variants.time: Each room gets named calendar blocks; weekly review of time spent and rooms left.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen reward for each room finished and a bigger one when the house is done.
approach_variants.resource: First week gathers bins, bags, a donation drop-off with opening times and any helpers.

guardrails: For lifting, ladders, power tools or electrical and gas work, use proper safety gear and hire a licensed professional where required.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: A missed session moves the room to the next slot. After a missed fortnight, the plan offers shorter sessions.
